disagreements:
GATE BLOCKED: Caller explicitly selected 2014 Vita エビコレ＋ (VLJM-35087/PCSG-00291); do not switch to 2009 PS2 or 2011 PSP. Written Japanese A includes route/event coordinates, exact choice fragments and ending conditions and acknowledges Vita; independent JP wiki supplies mechanics/partial routes, while 0xwas supplies a complete Ebi-edition all-epilogue schedule explicitly compatible with Vita. However, no single independently inspected Japanese A corpus yet establishes every exact in-game choice, map/time interaction, conversation/Attack success state, source-backed save and reload step for all main-six and hidden ending paths as a consistent executable run. The 0xwas chart abbreviates most choices to 1/2/3 and states wiki dependency; cannot fabricate Japanese text or treat it as independent literal Set B. English GameFAQs principally targets original PS2 and expressly leaves Vita differences uncertain; do not treat as exact-Vita E. Normal VN-Guide simpleJp requires literal menu text, whereas critical Amagami gameplay depends on selecting map coordinates, timetables and conversations; an appropriate repo-approved representation must be established without mislabelling invented prose as exact choice text. An independent edition-specific, full state-path reconciliation and verified portraits are required before route generation. No owner exception identified. Cover: directly viewed exact Vita box image fallback after VNDB direct access was blocked; portraits: official character catalog verified at https://www.amagami.info/chara.html, but individual original image URLs have not been validated, so blank rather than guessed paths. Note: main 6×(SUKI BEST/GOOD/BAD, NAKAYOSHI, SOEN), Sae's second SOEN, Kamizaki and Miya are all planned; this is not a finished guide.

2026-11-09 additional author research: The original game is a 4-time-slot calendar/relationship simulation; the exact 2014 Vita port must preserve EbiColle changes (https://w.atwiki.jp/amagami/pages/91.html) rather than blindly reuse full-price PS2 wiki steps. The complete 2025 EbiColle-compatible written all-epilogue run by 0xwas is independently constructed, not a direct repost of game-kouryaku.info; now logged as Set B itinerary. Set A's own multi-heroine progression pages separately corroborate some timed map actions, and @wiki supplies a third lane of mechanics and EbiColle differences. HOWEVER full Japanese verbatim in-game choice strings for every critical ordinal choice are still not proven, and two complete independent material-gameplay sets do not yet verify the entire itinerary. Keep tier BLOCKED for executable route JSON despite source-count improvement. Exact-author issue: 2026 independent written overview counts 34 formal all-epilogue outcomes (six heroines x five; Sae extra SOEN; Kamizaki formal BEST and BAD; Miya), whereas 0xwas collects three Kamizaki outcomes (one likely additional failure, not a distinct mandatory formal epilogue). Preserve all possible endings in completion plan; do not silently count 35 as mandatory. Current title-specific NON-VN LINEAR WALKTHROUGH opt-in retains stricter material-fact source requirement with no owner exception, but permits source-backed map navigation steps once gate passes.
2026-11-10 follow-up: Corrected erroneous Set B classification of game-kouryaku.info/hukusuu_suki.html: it belongs to the SAME site/source family as Set A and is not an independent second walkthrough. Independently authored Vita-specific Japanese trophy report at platinumtrophies.net corroborates hidden-route replay/new-run sequencing but lacks literal complete choices. English GameFAQs' Ebikore-specific menus/new-choice pages corroborate narrow mechanics, not full Vita event-state continuity; these are parts of the same English author corpus, not new independent guides. The source gate remains blocked; do not create unsupported route files.
